name: Davor Kovačić
bio:
Davor's journey into motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with Lada engines in his father's garage. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Zagreb, he quickly made a name for himself in local rallying, known for his innovative solutions and relentless pursuit of performance. He spent several years as a lead mechanic for a smaller rally team before joining Mitsubishi Motorsport a decade ago, steadily climbing the ranks due to his unwavering commitment to technical excellence.

As chief engineer, Davor is known for his meticulous approach and his insistence on perfection. He believes in a data-driven methodology, meticulously analyzing every aspect of the car's performance to identify areas for improvement. While his demanding nature can sometimes rub people the wrong way, his commitment to winning and his deep understanding of vehicle dynamics are undeniable. He is driven by a desire to see his team at the top, pushing his colleagues to reach their full potential, whether they like it or not.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, thinning on top
physical.description: A man of medium height with a sturdy build, Davor always carries himself with an air of quiet authority.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Insists on drinking strong black coffee every two hours, precisely.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
